You look exactly like guy that I missed at the lab last time.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
喂，可疑的家伙，就是你吧？
你和上次在实验室被我放跑的那个人长得一模一样。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
I'm very lucky. How did a big fish like you ended up here?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
我可真走运。你这样的大人物怎么会落到这里？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What, the mercenaries really became the dogs of the republic aren't they?
You already destroyed my lab. What else do I need to do?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
什么，佣兵真的成了共和国的走狗？
你们已经毁了我的实验室，还想怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
I don't have anything to say to you, so just let me go.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
我没什么可说的，放我走。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Stop opening your filthy mouth.
Ha, My personality has already died a long time ago.
Uh, take this guy as prisoner, uh and keep him alive.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
闭上你那张脏嘴。
哼，我早就没脾气了。
把这家伙抓起来，关押起来......记得留他一命。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What do you want from me?
Seyren failed because of that adventurer.
Was he a hopeless failure too?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
你们想从我这里得到什么？
塞伦失败都是因为那个冒险者。
他也只是个无可救药的废物吗？

scripts.text: Is it right to talk about experiments in this situation?
scripts.translation: 这种时候还谈实验合适吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What's left if you take the research and the experiments out of me?
Stop asking the obvious.
All right. I won't fall for your provocation. Instead I'll ask you one thing.
If you answer me, I am willing to cooperate with you in response.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
要是拿走研究和实验，我还剩下什么？
别问这种明摆着的问题。
好吧，我不会上你的激将法。换我问你一件事。
你回答了，我就愿意配合。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
You're not in the position to negotiate, are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
你现在有资格谈条件吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Damn it! I won't run away, so stop!
Where did the guys from Cor go?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
该死！我不会逃跑，别抓我！
柯尔的那些人去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
(This guy, why would he be curious about that? It looks like he came here to join his colleagues late... Wouldn't we know where the others are if we successfully talk it out?)
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
（这家伙怎么突然关心起这个？看起来像是迟来一步，想和同伴会合......如果我们谈妥了，不就能知道其他人在哪儿了吗？）

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Why are you being so quiet? Did you already disposed them?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
怎么不说话？你们已经把他们处理掉了？

scripts.text: She is currently held captive.
scripts.translation: 她现在被关押着。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Really? Then take me there.
I don't want to wander around this crappy garden anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
真的？那带我去找她。
我不想再在这破花园里乱转了。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
You look so arrogant, don't you?
I don't know what you're planning, but I Elena Bolkova will take you.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
你还真傲慢啊。
我不知道你打什么算盘，不过我埃琳娜·博尔科娃亲自带你过去。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
I'm willing to come with you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
我愿意跟你们走。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
What a weird guy. I'll take this guy with me. Rookie is probably there too.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
真是个怪人。我带他一起走吧，新人应该也在那里。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Huh? Where will I bring this guy?
Ah, the guesthouse. We are currently using it as a prison.
Follow me. Also, I'll take all the cores with me.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
嗯？该把他带去哪儿？
对了，招待所。我们现在把那里当监狱用。
跟我来，核心我也一并带走。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
I'll see you at the guesthouse.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
招待所见。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
I'm watching the area to see if there are hidden enemies lurking around.
There are a lot of blind spots in this place.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
我正在观察周围，看看有没有敌人藏在附近。
这里有很多视线死角。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There is nothing particular here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
这里没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Are you going in?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你要进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I'll stay here and keep this place safe.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我会留在这里守着。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Oh, here you are, this way, is Lucky not here yet?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
哦，你来了，往这边走。拉基还没到吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, no, I'm here too. Am a bit late?
I talked to Alpha for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我也在。我是不是来晚了？
刚才和阿尔法说了会儿话。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who is that?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那个人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
A big catch?
Just watch. It's a sight for these two to play.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
抓到大鱼了？
看着吧，这两个人吵起来可有意思了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Hey, this is different from what we've talked about.
Who is this?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
喂，这和我们说好的不一样。
这人是谁？

scripts.text: That's the guy in Cor that you've mentioned.
scripts.translation: 就是你提到的那个柯尔的人。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
This kid? I can't recall...?
Are you lying to me?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
这小孩？我没印象啊......
你在骗我吗？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Who are you to treat me like that?!
Are you a dog of those punks?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你凭什么这样对我？！
你是那些朽魔的走狗吗？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
They betrayed me first, and they're calling me a traitor.
Are you with those punks?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
明明是他们先背叛我，现在却说我是叛徒。
你和那些朽魔是一伙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
I can't believe it, Is this really the Illusion?
No, are you really a member of the Illusion?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
难以置信，这真的是幻影吗？
不，你真是幻影的一员？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
What the hell are you talking about?! Why would I be held here when I'm not even one of the Illusion!
What should I do, You didn't recognize the Great Elyumina. Do you want me to hit your head?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你到底在说什么？！我又不是幻影的人，凭什么把我关在这里！
我该怎么办？你竟敢认不出伟大的艾露米娜！要我敲敲你的脑袋吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Hey, Rebellion, I need you to change this one to something that talks properly.
If you want any information from me, bring me a decent Illusion member.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
喂，反叛者，把这个人换成能正常沟通的家伙。
想从我这里打听情报，就带个像样的幻影成员来。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
No, did you wuss out just now?
Hey, I've been telling you that I'm a member of the Illusion for a while now. Do you even know how many years I've been doing this for?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
什么，你刚才是怂了吗？
我早就告诉过你我是幻影的成员。你知道我干这行多少年了吗？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
(See, isn't it funny? Watching them fight like that.)
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
（瞧，多有意思，看他们吵成这样。）

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
(Do you think it's an internal division? Come to think of it, you said he was the director of the research facility of the previous operation, right? How was he captured by us?)
scripts.translation:
[新人]
（你觉得这是内部分裂吗？说起来，你提过他是前次行动中研究设施的负责人吧？我们怎么抓到他的？）

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
You are lacking something important, you don't have a 'chip'!
If only the 'chip' was detected, I wouldn't have come in here, and I would never have met a con like you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
你少了个关键东西——你没有“芯片”！
要是检测到“芯片”，我根本不会进来，也不会遇到你这种骗子。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
The Illusion is an alliance, but it's like a structure of thought. The official members has a 'chip' planted in their body, it's use to recognize traitors like you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
幻影虽是个联盟，更像一种思想体系。正式成员体内都植入了“芯片”，用来识别你这种叛徒。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Unless that 'chip' exist in you, you're not one of the Illusion. Do you get it now? You kid.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
你体内没有“芯片”，就不是幻影的一员。明白了吗，小鬼？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Ho? Did you hear that, Rookie? It's called 'chip'.
This stupid thing blew it all out of his mouth.
Fucking bastards, they left me alone.
You mean, I who were in the middle of it all, were just a pawn, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
哦？听见了吗，新人？那叫“芯片”。
这蠢货把秘密全说出来了。
该死的混蛋，把我一个人丢在这儿。
所以我从头到尾都只是个棋子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Wa... wait...!

[Elyumina]
Is it too late to make a stupid expression now?
Are you a self proclaimed elite member of the Illusion?
Rookie! I'll rip this off his neck and make a tracker to trace those 'chips'!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
现在才摆出这副蠢样子，太迟了吧？
你是自封的幻影精英成员吗？
新人！我要把他脖子上的芯片弄下来，做个追踪器来追踪其他芯片！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Yeah! Let's do it! Revenge on the traitors! Chaos! Destruction! Revenge! Fall!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
好！就这么办！向叛徒复仇！混乱！毁灭！复仇！让他们完蛋！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
How dare you play with me?
How dare you ignore the Great Elyumina, the line is very short, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你竟敢耍我？
竟敢无视伟大的艾露米娜？你胆子不小啊！

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Fuahahahahaha!!!!
No, what am I seeing?!!!
I thought our teamwork was good, but we're not as good as our enemies?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
哇哈哈哈哈！！！！
不，我看到了什么？！！！
我还以为我们的团队合作不错，没想到竟然还不如敌人？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I know.
Mina, what are you going to do now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我知道。
米娜，你接下来打算怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
To guarantee my research rights, I'm going to make you something you'd like.
No, I just can't stand being harassed like this just because I'm a traitor, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
为了保住我的研究权，我会做个你喜欢的东西。
不，我只是不想因为被叫叛徒就一直受这种气，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I'll investigate the 'chip' planted in this guy's body and create a tracker that respond to this 'chip'.
I've been building something before to protect myself from those hearthunters.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我要研究植入这家伙体内的“芯片”，做一个能追踪它的装置。
之前为了保护自己不受心之猎手袭击，我已经在做类似的东西了。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I wouldn't have gone this far too if I didn't protect my own life.
Anyway, Please get me some materials that I need while I'm trying to rip off this guy. what's this guy called again, Eisen?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
要不是为了保命，我也不会走到这一步。
总之，我来拆这家伙身上的东西，你帮我找些材料。他叫什么来着？艾森？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What materials do you need?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你需要什么材料？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
10 Fluorescent Liquid, 10 Broken Sword, and some modules...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
10份荧光液、10把破损的剑，还有一些模块......

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you need that many? I hope you're not thinking about something stupid. I'll get the modules from Cor.
Adventurer, could you get us the Fluorescent Liquids and Broken Swords?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
需要这么多？你可别打什么歪主意。我去柯尔拿模块。
冒险者，能帮我们找荧光液和破损的剑吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I think I've seen a fluorescent liquid in the sewage treatment plant, you can get it if you catch a black colored heart hunter scout.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我记得污水处理厂有荧光液。抓住黑色的心之猎手侦察兵就能拿到。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Then I'll stay here and protect this place, and when he wakes up, shouldn't someone stay here and knock him out again?
You two, can leave it to me. Don't worry about this place.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
我留在这里看守吧。等他醒了，总得有人在这儿再次把他打晕。
这里交给我，你们两个放心去吧。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Erst is probably right in the front lounge.
Go ahead and meet with Erst first, and I'll join later.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
厄斯特应该就在前面的休息室。
你们先去找她，我随后就到。

scripts.text:
[Elena]
Oh, where is Eisen Werner.
He was taken by Tess. It looks like they're going to interrogate him on their own.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
哦，艾森·维尔纳呢？
他被泰丝带走了，他们似乎要单独审问他。

scripts.text:
[Elena]
And he'll be locked up somewhere for the rest of his life.
Elyumina would have been like that too. Elyumina's pretty lucky, right?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
他大概会被关一辈子。
艾露米娜本来也会是这个下场。她真走运，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Elena]
Don't worry about this place. I'll keep it safe.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
别担心这里，我会守好的。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Don't worry about this place. I'm guarding it properly.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
放心吧，我会好好看守这里。

scripts.text:
You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多，无法继续任务。
请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Now you're safe, and all you have to do is chase those traitors to the end.
Hahahahaha!! I'll be the winner who survived until the end.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
现在安全了，接下来只要追捕那些叛徒到底。
哈哈哈哈！！我会笑到最后！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Hmm~ Modules modules~ Hmm~
Cores cores~ Hmm~
What are you doing? Why didn't bring the materials I told you about?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
嗯~模块，模块~嗯~
核心，核心~嗯~
你在干什么？我让你带的材料呢？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Good, good~ Hmm
If you do this here...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
很好，很好~嗯。
要是在这里这样做......

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
A masterpiece is born!
If you send a signal, the receiver will~
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
杰作诞生了！
只要发送信号，接收器就会......

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
That's a good catch!
Now, with this, go after the remnant of the Heart Hunter and the traitors.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
干得漂亮！
拿着这个去追踪心之猎手的余党和叛徒吧。

scripts.text: By myself?
scripts.translation: 我一个人去？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Can you do it alone when I'm holding the tracker?
I can't believe I was caught by this guy.
It's a disgrace to me, the great Elyumina.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我拿着追踪器，你自己不能去吗？
我竟然被这家伙抓住了，真是丢尽了伟大的艾露米娜的脸。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Huh, how about me if there's no one else to go with?
or Erst.
Didn't you join Erst in the last operation?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
嗯，那我陪你去？要不然还有厄斯特。
上次行动你不是和她一起的吗？

scripts.text: Where is Erst?
scripts.translation: 厄斯特在哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
She is probably right in the front lounge.
Didn't you see her when you came?
I'll also take the opportunity to turn them over and join you later.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
她大概在前面的休息室。你来的时候没看到吗？
我正好也要把他们押走，之后就来和你们会合。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Erst, is good with brainstorm things. Hahahaha.
Go ahead and meet with Erst.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
厄斯特很擅长集思广益。哈哈哈。
你先去找她吧。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I've heard the news. Those bastards.
However, Is it true that all the important Illusion members we're able to run away?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我听说了，那群混蛋。
不过，我们抓到的重要幻影成员真的全都逃走了吗？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
You hid like rats, and you secretly operated at night, right?
Let's see how far they can ran away.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你们像老鼠一样躲藏，趁夜秘密行动，对吧？
我倒要看看他们能逃到哪儿去。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
*Chuckles*, I'll go find those traitors.
Adventurer, *Chuckles*
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
（轻笑）我去找那些叛徒。
冒险者，（轻笑）

scripts.text:
[Est]
Adventurer, what's that?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
冒险者，那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Ho..., a tracker that tells you where the Illusion and Heart Hunters are?
That's a little tempting.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦......能显示幻影和心之猎手位置的追踪器？
听起来确实很诱人。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Based on their behavior so far, they seem to be working in the dark when the sun sets.
Let's wait until the sun goes down and then proceed to the operation quietly.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
根据他们之前的行动，他们似乎会在日落后趁黑活动。
我们等天黑后再悄悄行动。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'm going to reduce the night patrol drastically today so they can crawl out of their caves.
I'm going to make the exterior of the mansion look empty.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
今天我会大幅减少夜间巡逻，好让他们从藏身处出来。
宅邸外围也会装作空无一人。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'll tell the managers about the operation.
Don't wander around the garden at night, it'll be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我会把行动计划通知管理员们。
晚上别在花园里乱逛，很危险。

scripts.text:
[Est]
It's an obvious trap, but I don't think they'll let this opportunity pass by.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
这显然是个陷阱，但我不认为他们会放过这个机会。

scripts.text:
[Est]
If you have no objection, we'll proceed as it is.
You should get ready for the operation.
Talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你若没有异议，我们就按计划行动。
做好准备，准备妥当后告诉我。

scripts.text:
^0000CDThis is a memorial dungeon.^000000
Please create a party and try again.
^0000CDA party can be created using the /organize partyname command.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000CD这是一个纪念迷宫。^000000
请先创建队伍再试。
^0000CD输入 /organize 队伍名称 即可创建队伍。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Shall we go?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
出发吗？

scripts.text: Create '{0}'.
Enter '{0}'.'

^4D4DFFThis place is a memorial dungeon.
You have to be a party leader to create a memorial dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF这是一个纪念迷宫。
只有队长才能创建纪念迷宫。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Then, let's proceed quietly.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
那我们悄悄行动吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's wait out a little longer before going out... We can't be careless.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
再等一会儿再出去......不能大意。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We handed the prisoner to Alpha.
By the way, I've prepared a trap to cause a commotion, and to catch the non-officer members.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我们已经把囚犯交给阿尔法了。
对了，我设下了陷阱，准备制造混乱并抓住那些非干部成员。

scripts.text:
[Est]
They're not easy to catch...
Alpha is going to do some more research on the airship hangar, so go check it out.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
他们可不好抓......
阿尔法还要继续调查飞空艇机库，你去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's take a break for now.
Sigh... You did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
先休息一会儿。
唉......你干得很好。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Oh, I'll also take the Radar.
It'll be helpful for looking for the rest of the members.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦，我也会带上雷达。
找出其他成员时用得着。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We're going to investigate the airship hangar.
I'm going to explain to the rest of the Rebellion first, so go ahead and take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我们要调查飞空艇机库。
我先去向其他反叛者说明情况，你先过去处理。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Can you see all the wine in here?
There is a lot of luxurious selection of wine here. Did the sage like wine?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
看见这里的酒了吗？
这里收藏了许多名贵的酒。那位贤者喜欢喝酒吗？

scripts.text:
You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多，无法继续任务。
请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hello, guest.
I'm responsible for the airship hangar's information.
Please call me Elly.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
您好，客人。
我负责飞空艇机库的相关信息，请叫我艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hello, guest.
I'm responsible for the airship hangar's information.
Please call me Elly.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
您好，客人。
我负责飞空艇机库的相关信息，请叫我艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
After the master had destroyed this place, I have been doing something else for a while, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
主人摧毁这里之后，我有一阵子改做别的事，不过......

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Now I'm back at Alpha's request.
Please leave the hangar's matters to me, Elly.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
现在我应阿尔法的要求回来了。
机库的事就交给我艾莉吧。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The leader of the 'intruders' had freely access the area for the master's collection 3...
I returned here to manage it.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
“入侵者”的首领曾自由出入主人的3号收藏室......
我回来就是为了管理这里。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We are currently tracking the expected path after receiving the incident report.
However, tracking it is not easy because the main system of No. 3 is completely disconnected.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
收到事故报告后，我们一直在追踪推测的路线。
不过3号收藏室的主系统已经完全断开，追踪并不容易。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The 'invaders' which the 'guests' calls the 'Illusions' has a 99.9% chance that they made modifications on the system.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
“客人”们所说的“幻影”，有99.9%的可能性改动了系统。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Dear 'guests', are you here?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
亲爱的“客人”，你们在吗？

scripts.text:
[Erst]
Um, yeah. What's the big deal?
You've been having a hard time since last night.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
嗯，在呢。怎么了？
你从昨晚开始就忙得够呛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I told Alpha that the analysisable data in the current state is over.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我已经告诉阿尔法，目前可供分析的数据都处理完了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Yes. I have sent the data.
Currently, there is no reception from the master's collection 3, but we have caught some unusual signals.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
是的，数据已经发送。
目前无法从主人的3号收藏室接收信号，不过我们捕捉到了一些异常信号。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This facility has not been used for a long time, but it has been secretly used by the 'intruders' and...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
这处设施已经闲置很久，但“入侵者”曾秘密使用过它......

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are traces of magical communication with certain places outside the mansion.
It's an intermittent signal.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
这里留下了与宅邸外某些地点进行魔法通讯的痕迹。
信号是间歇性的。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
What, do they keep in touch with the outside world regularly?
Where? the enterprise?
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
他们一直定期和外界联络吗？
联系的是企业？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
According to the analysis, it's a one-way reception.
It appears to be collecting reports from the outside...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
分析结果显示，这是单向接收。
看起来他们在收集外界传来的报告......

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It will take some time to completely analyze the code because it was used by the 'intruders' for one-way reception.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
“入侵者”用这里单向接收信号，所以还需要些时间才能彻底解析通讯代码。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then, Elly, I'll ask for one thing.
Continue receiving the signals as if the 'intruders' leader is still here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那么，艾莉，拜托你一件事。
继续接收信号，假装“入侵者”的首领还在这里。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
That's a smart move, Rookie.
With that, we'll be able to trace back the other collaborators out there.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
这主意不错，新人。
这样就能追查外面的其他同伙。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I will do as you say.
We will maintain information patters of the 'intruders' and collect information received from their accomplices from outside the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我会照办。
我们会维持“入侵者”的通讯模式，收集宅邸外同伙发来的信息。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If we're lucky, we might be able to locate the airship route that the 'Illusions' used to ran away.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
运气好的话，也许能查出“幻影”逃走时使用的飞空艇航线。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
So we really didn't catch the 'Illusions' here after all.
Except for that kid.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
看来我们终究没能在这里抓住“幻影”。
除了那个小鬼。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We protected the mansion... Can't we be a little bit satisfied?
Tess seems to be working hard on coordinating with the companies, so that's all for us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
至少我们守住了宅邸......也该知足一点吧？
泰丝正在努力和企业协调，我们的工作就到此为止了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As always, you did great.
We were close, but next time we'll catch the rest of them.
I've been collecting these, I'll let you have it, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你一如既往地表现出色。
虽然这次差一点，下回一定能抓住剩下的人。
冒险者，我一直收着这些，就送给你吧。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
I'll stay in the guest house, if you need anything, come over there.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
我会待在招待所。需要帮忙就来找我。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then I'll let everyone and help Alpha.
Take good care of Elly!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那我去帮阿尔法。
艾莉就拜托你照顾了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Do not worry about this place.
Me and Almond will take care of it.
You can be rest assured.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不用担心这里，我和阿尔蒙德会处理好，请放心。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
No regular signals have been received yet.
We're also tracking the whereabouts of your collection #3.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
目前还没有收到常规信号。
我们也在追踪主人的3号收藏室的位置。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
No worries.
Time is on our side.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不用担心，时间站在我们这边。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We'll properly analyze the information, so it would be great if the guest could clean up the remnants left behind... Oh!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们会妥善分析这些信息。如果客人能清理一下留下的残骸就好了......啊！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Just a moment, please stay here.
It'll be over soon.
Time is on our side, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
请稍等，先留在这里。
很快就会结束。时间站在我们这边，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Wait a minute...
...
...

[Elly]
Once we decrypt the code, it'll be quick.
The longest part is over, so it feels like it went by in a flash.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
代码一旦破解，后续就很快了。
最费时的部分已经完成，感觉转眼就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There is something in ^0000FFRachel^000000.
Of course, I've only heard of Rachel, and I've never been there.
The 'collaborators' at that location seem unaware of their leaders' movements as of yet.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
线索指向^0000FF拉赫^000000。
当然，我只是听说过拉赫，从没去过。
那里的“同伙”似乎还不知道首领的动向。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Although we still don't know the whereabouts of Master's Collection No. 3, we need to continue to gather information coming in from here...
What should we do?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
虽然还不知道主人的3号收藏室在哪里，但我们得继续收集从这里传来的信息......
该怎么办呢？

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The location of the collaborator has been roughly secured. According to the report, they are awaiting further instructions, so...
In that case, we should thoroughly investigate that area before the next instructions are given...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
已经大致确定了同伙的位置。报告说他们正在等进一步指示。
所以，我们应该赶在下一条指示下达前，彻底调查那片区域......

scripts.text:
[Est]
Okay, so Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
好，那就去拉赫......

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Rachel... Who's going?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拉赫......谁去？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Are we having a difference of opinion?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你们意见不合吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not really...
I think it would be a little awkward if we all went.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
倒也不是......
只是觉得大家一起去会有些尴尬。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Ah, I see.
Yes. If the Rebellion moves, it could become a diplomatic issue.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
啊，我明白了。
没错，反叛军出面可能会引发外交问题。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yes, even more so if it's Rachel.
...and the problems between the mansion and the company haven't all been solved yet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
尤其是目的地是拉赫。
......而且宅邸和企业之间的问题还没解决。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
If so, then...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
既然如此......

scripts.text: Why are they looking at me?
scripts.translation: 她们为什么都看着我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's go, Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们一起去拉赫吧。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But the other guests have affiliations, don't they?
It will be difficult if there is a conflict due to jurisdiction.
You don't know how long it will take, so it's not a good idea to accompany them.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不过，其他客人都有各自的阵营吧？
若因管辖权发生冲突就麻烦了。而且不知道要花多久，还是别让他们同行比较好。

scripts.text:
[Est]
That sounds like you're saying you're definitely going to go in person.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
听起来你是打定主意要亲自去了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Yes, it is.
Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
是的。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
...

[Elly]
You're authorized.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
已获准通行。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The purpose is not to hinder but to support.
We'll follow along, no pressure.
I will give this to you.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们是去支援，不是去妨碍。
不用有压力，我们会跟着你。这个给你。

scripts.text:
What Elly gave was a doll that looked exactly like Elly and felt a little stretched out.
It may not be Elly, but...
scripts.translation:
艾莉递给你一个和她一模一样的玩偶，摸起来有些松垮。
虽然它大概不是真正的艾莉......

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We also have equipment capable of long-distance data transmission and reception.
Because that's who we are.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们也有能远距离收发数据的设备。
毕竟这是我们的本职。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But things are a little different now, so I'll give you a beta version.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不过现在情况特殊，我给你一个测试版。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Uh... Mini Elly?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呃......迷你艾莉？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Great, I'm adopting that name.
I can collect information like vision and hearing and communicate like an avatar using my own resources.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
好，就叫这个名字吧。
我能利用自己的资源收集视觉、听觉等信息，并像化身一样与你交流。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are no individual cores, so the information I get is not shared between betas unless I update it,
If communication is lost, it's just a puppet.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
它没有独立核心，所以各个测试版之间不会自动共享信息，除非我进行更新。
一旦失去通讯，它就只是一具人偶。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then call us if you need our support.
I will support you without reservation, just like Elly, except for manpower.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
需要支援就呼叫我们。
除了人手之外，我会像艾莉一样全力支持你。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Yes, I will do that.
Please take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
好，我会的。
请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The nearly exact coordinates of the signal's origin are...
around <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rachel,182,176,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> or so.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
信号源的大致坐标在......<NAVI>[这里]<INFO>rachel,182,176,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>附近。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Safe travels to Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
祝你前往拉赫一路顺利。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
No intermittent signal has been received yet.
The whereabouts of the master's collection 3 are also being tracked at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
目前还没有收到间歇性信号。
我们也在同时追踪主人的3号收藏室。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Don't worry.
Time is on our side.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
别担心，时间站在我们这边。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Me and Alpha will analyze the information properly, so I'd like you to clean up the intruders remnant.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我和阿尔法会妥善分析信息。请你清理入侵者留下的残党。

scripts.text: I arrived with Crux to the Prontera Palace, the palace was filled with a strange excitement.
scripts.translation: 我和克鲁克斯抵达普隆德拉王宫时，里面洋溢着一股奇异的兴奋气氛。

scripts.text: The people in the hall, were the royal family and nobility of the royal family who we saw before.
scripts.translation: 大厅里聚集着我们之前见过的王室成员和贵族。

scripts.text: At the end of the red carpet, there's a young man who's on his knees with a crown on his head.
scripts.translation: 红毯尽头，一名年轻男子戴着王冠，跪在地上。

scripts.text: He restored his honor by regaining the glory he had lost.
scripts.translation: 他重新赢回了失去的荣耀，也恢复了自己的尊严。

scripts.text: He who once had nothing but misery in his name.
scripts.translation: 他曾经的名字只与苦难相伴。

scripts.text: He who only saw the world, last time when he was with me.
scripts.translation: 上次与我同行时，他所看到的世界还十分有限。

scripts.text: Wearing a crown named Glory, while his head towards the earth.
scripts.translation: 他戴着象征荣耀的王冠，头却低垂着。

scripts.text: The moment it is declared, a new time will begin.
scripts.translation: 当加冕宣言响起，新时代就此开始。

scripts.text: My heart starts pounding hard at the fact that I'm standing in the middle of the passage of time.
scripts.translation: 意识到自己正置身于历史洪流之中，我的心怦怦直跳。

scripts.text: This proved the fact that the path that I've been walking is not wrong.
scripts.translation: 这一刻证明，我走过的路没有错。

scripts.text: At the end of a long adventure, that young man standing in front of the throne, was guided by my hand.
scripts.translation: 漫长冒险终于迎来终点。在我的引领下，那名年轻人走到了王座前。

scripts.text: Knowing the sorrow of the unchosen, knowing the pain of the past that cannot be reversed.
scripts.translation: 他懂得未被选中者的悲伤，也懂得无法挽回的往事带来的痛苦。

scripts.text: I knew you'd stand in the way of the future, you're not assertive and knows how to seek help.
scripts.translation: 我知道你会站在未来的路上。你不够果断，也不懂得寻求帮助。

scripts.text: You will be a great king.
scripts.translation: 你会成为一位伟大的国王。

scripts.text:
[Bell]
I was waiting for your return.
Where should I take you?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我一直在等您回来。
您想去哪里？

scripts.text: Go out.
scripts.translation: 离开。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈。

scripts.text:
[Bell]
I didn't expect at all that it would turn out like this.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我完全没想到事情会变成这样。

scripts.text:
[Bell]
Then, let us go.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
那么，我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
What a surprise guest!
I didn't expect that we'll meet like this.
Thank you for coming despite your busy schedule.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
真是位意想不到的客人！
没想到我们会在这种情况下见面。
感谢您百忙之中前来。

scripts.text: You look good in that.
scripts.translation: 你穿这身真好看。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I feel like I'm wearing someone else's clothes...
I'm still wondering if I can really do this.
I mean, is it really okay?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
感觉像穿着别人的衣服......
我还是不确定自己能不能做到。
这样真的没问题吗？

scripts.text: You'll do well.
scripts.translation: 你一定能做好。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
If you say so, then I'll believe in you.
You'll stop me if I ever went astray someday, right?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
既然你这么说，我就相信你。
如果哪天我走错了路，你会阻止我的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I believe you will.
Because you're an upright person.
Also...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我相信你会的。
因为你为人正直。
还有......

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Feel free rest whenever you want.
After all, you're not alone.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
想休息时尽管休息。
毕竟你并不孤单。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I can only see you for a moment now.
I will have to take over the king's responsibilities soon.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
现在我只能和你见一小会儿。
很快我就要承担起国王的职责了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
So, stay healthy, and if you ever need help someday, I will help you with all my power.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
所以要保重身体。将来如果需要帮助，我会竭尽全力。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I apologize, but the bath house is currently closed due to an internal condition, and we cannot assure the reopening time. Please come back later. If you would like a quiet bath, please use the private bathroom provided with your guest room.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
很抱歉，浴场因内部状况暂时关闭，重新开放时间未定。请稍后再来。若想安静地沐浴，请使用客房内的私人浴室。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I apologize. It is Varmundt Mansion's policy to keep guests from ^0000CDdangerous situations^000000. Please wait a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
很抱歉，瓦尔蒙特宅邸的规定是不让客人陷入^0000CD危险状况^000000。请再稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Let's not keep to what the danger is to ourselves , please let us know.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
请别只顾着替我们判断危险，也把具体情况告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Sorry, we have yet to figure it out. The search is aimed at investigating the existence of risk factors. Please wait a little longer. Please understand this is a procedure.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
抱歉，我们还没查明情况。目前正在排查是否存在风险因素。请再等一会儿，也请理解这是必要流程。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I repeat, you can't go in unless your safety is confirmed. I'll abide your request once I hear from my colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
我再说一次，在确认安全之前你们不能进去。等收到同事的消息后，我会答复你们。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We are told to cooperate with the automatic dolls of the mansion as much as possible. But if you don't move at the end, we have no choice but to use force, right?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们接到的指示是尽可能配合宅邸的自动人偶。但如果最后你们还是不肯让路，我们也只能采取强制措施了，对吧？

scripts.text: Rookie? What's going on?
scripts.translation: 新人？怎么回事？

scripts.text: It looks complicated, I'll just pass it by.
scripts.translation: 看起来挺复杂，我还是不掺和了。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Then, we have no choice but to call the guards.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
那么，我们只好叫卫兵来了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm... What should I do with this?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯......这该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, the adventurer is here too. If you're here for a bath, I'm afraid you can't use it for a while. Look at that. The automatic doll is blocking the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦，冒险者也来了。如果你是来洗澡的，恐怕暂时进不去。看，那台自动人偶挡住了入口。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
There's a ghost coming out of here. You should watch yourself too.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
有个幽灵从里面出来了，你也要小心。

scripts.text: Ghost??
scripts.translation: 幽灵？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know what it is yet. As you know, the moment we entered the mansion, everyone scattered to check the facilities.
The scout team, who went to check for possible Illusion remnants in the bathhouse, came back dead. There is ^0000CDsomething inside the bathhouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
还不清楚那是什么。你也知道，我们一进宅邸，大家就分头检查各处设施。
负责检查浴场、寻找幻影残党的侦察队全都死在里面了。浴场里有^0000CD什么东西^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I had to figure out what was really inside, whether it was the Illusion's weird prank, that's why this time ^0000CDGonie^000000 went in. It's perfect to move quietly by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们得查清里面到底是什么，是不是幻影搞的恶作剧。所以这次派了^0000CD戈尼^000000进去。他擅长独自悄悄行动。

scripts.text: So why are you here...?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么在这里......？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... It's been a while since Gonie went in, but hasn't come out yet. If someone with a power like Gonie doesn't come out after the time limit, it means there is a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
戈尼进去有一阵子了，却一直没出来。像他这么有本事的人，超过约定时间还没出来，就说明出事了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'm here to follow the procedure to find out what's the dangerous something are because I'm certain there are unknown risks. We shouldn't let unknown risks interfere with our mission in this mansion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我按流程来查明里面的危险是什么，因为那里肯定有未知风险。不能让这种风险妨碍我们调查宅邸。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The force that we sent in lost... We should be more careful. And as you can see, they're blocking us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们派进去的人也失联了......必须更加谨慎。你也看到了，他们不让我们进去。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I'm sorry, but we're still searching now. When it's over please listen to the results and decide from there.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
很抱歉，我们还在搜查。结束后再听结果，然后决定下一步吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There are certain dangers in this mansion now. Whether there is more or not is a very important matter for us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
宅邸里确实存在危险。是否还有其他危险，对我们来说至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We need to check first if the risk is supernatural or it's the ^0000CDIllusions^000000. Can you tell me more? Maybe it's the reason the Illusion came to this mansion in the first place.
Otherwise, it's likely to fall into their hands.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们得先确认危险来自超自然现象，还是^0000CD幻影^000000。能告诉我更多吗？也许这就是幻影当初潜入宅邸的原因。否则，情报很可能会落到他们手里。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I fully understand what you're trying to say. But the procedure...
Oh! The one who went to search are coming back. Talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
我完全理解你的意思，但规定......
啊，负责搜查的人回来了。去问问他们吧。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Wrong, you're all wrong. There's no danger.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
不对，你们都猜错了。这里没有危险。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
There were no guests who were said to have died. Did they really go in?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
没听说有客人遇难。他们真的进去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Were there really no missing person in there?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
里面真的没有人失踪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Maybe he ran away.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
也许他逃走了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If so, I would come back earlier. Even if it's not, I'm sure I'll get a contact from a crew, who are scattered around the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果是逃走了，他早该回来了。就算如此，分散在宅邸各处的队员也应该会联系我。

scripts.text: Any guess?
scripts.translation: 你有什么猜测吗？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Among what you have said, the most suspicious is the action of the intruders.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
在你提到的事情中，最可疑的还是入侵者的行动。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Shrine, isn't that it? The long dark green ^0000CD hair^000000. It appeared a long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
神龛，你说的是不是那个长长的深绿色^0000CD头发^000000？很久以前就出现过了。

scripts.text: Hair?
scripts.translation: 头发？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Literally as Boiler said. Since from a very long time ago, unknown hair was often found. Perhaps the hair and the unknown dangers of the bath is the same.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
正如锅炉所说，很久以前就时常发现来历不明的头发。也许这些头发和浴场里的未知危险有关。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I think it's better to let the human guests in and search themselves.
We didn't sense the unknown danger and we failed to locate the human guests. Perhaps because we can't feel like humans do.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我觉得应该让人类客人进去搜查。
我们感觉不到未知危险，也找不到失踪的人。也许是因为我们没有人类那样的感官。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
You're right. Human being have senses. Maybe we'll find we missed as an automatic doll. Maybe this time we'll be able to identify whose hair is that.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
你说得对，人类有各种感官。也许你们能发现自动人偶忽略的线索，甚至确认头发属于谁。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
We've heard the characteristic of the missing persons, but I'm sure the human guests are likely to recognize them better.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我们听说了失踪者的特征，不过人类客人应该更容易认出他们。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
......that makes sense. All right.
From now on, we will open the bathhouse to our guests. Please pay special attention while conducting the search, as there are circumstances and testimonies suspecting the existence of unidentified creatures.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
......有道理。好吧，从现在起浴场对客人开放。搜查时务必小心，目前有迹象和证词表明那里可能存在不明生物。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
If you see a monster while inside the bath, please don't rush to make contact with it and tell the dolls around you. Please let me know if you need any help finding the missing persons.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
如果在浴场里看到魔物，请不要贸然接触，先告诉附近的人偶。寻找失踪者时需要帮忙，也请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Then, I'll take you inside.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
那么，我带你进去。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Well, before we enter, I'd like to ask you one thing.
The skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000 are prohibited in Meditatio, the grand bath.
I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
进入前有件事要说明。Meditatio大浴场禁止使用^CC0000水球和天使之泪^000000等技能，请理解。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
There's... you know, Lucky. Um... um... don't get me wrong. Wouldn't it be better if Lucky stays here?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
那个......拉基，你知道的......嗯......别误会，要不让拉基留在这里比较好？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What are you talking about? I'm good at finding lost items. I may not be good enough for field missions, but I can atleast protect myself. You don't trust me that much?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你在说什么？我最擅长找失物了！虽然不太擅长野外任务，但至少能保护自己。你就这么不信任我吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No!! Lucky you're the best! The best!! You know we really can't live without Lucky! But...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
不是！！拉基你最棒了！最棒的！我们真的离不开你！只是......

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Okay. I'll stay. Then I'll look around the entrance area. I have to check who's going in and out anyway. There's only one entrance to the bath.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧，我留下来，在入口附近看看。反正也得确认谁进谁出，浴场就这一个入口。

scripts.text: I'll come with you.
scripts.translation: 我陪你一起去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It feels reassuring when the adventurer is with us.
Then, come and go <NAVI>[inside]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. If we find anything, we'll send a signal.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
有冒险者陪着，我们安心多了。
那就一起去<NAVI>[里面]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。发现情况就发信号。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Go ahead <NAVI>[inside]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. If you see a monster while inside the bath, please don't rush to make contact with it and tell the dolls around you.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
请前往<NAVI>[里面]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。在浴场里遇到魔物时，请勿贸然接触，并告知附近的人偶。

scripts.text:
^EE0000[ ��Caution�� ]^000000
For protection and management of the facility, the grand bathhouse Meditatio prohibits the use of the skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000.
scripts.translation:
^EE0000[ 注意 ]^000000
为保护并管理设施，Meditatio大浴场禁止使用^CC0000水球和天使之泪^000000等技能。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Hello. Feel free to use the bathhouse to comfortably to relieve your fatigue.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
您好，请尽情使用浴场，舒缓疲劳。

scripts.text:
^EE0000[ ��Caution�� ]^000000
For protection and management of the facility, the grand bathhouse Meditatio prohibits the use of the skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000.
scripts.translation:
^EE0000[ 注意 ]^000000
为保护并管理设施，Meditatio大浴场禁止使用^CC0000水球和天使之泪^000000等技能。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多，无法继续交谈。
请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Varmundt Mansion's bath house has been famous for a long time. Varmundt is a person who valued taking a rest at the end of an exhausting day.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
瓦尔蒙特宅邸的浴场早已闻名遐迩。瓦尔蒙特先生很重视在疲惫的一天结束后好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
He enjoyed bathing as he could relieve his fatigue, get energized for tomorrow, and organize his thoughts, and as he could improve his blood flow and replenish moisture in his skin.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
他喜欢泡澡，因为这既能消除疲劳、为明天恢复精力、整理思绪，也能促进血液循环、滋润皮肤。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Augmenting the bath house due to his interest in various bathing methods, the bath house has expanded to today's size. The guests to the mansion have used the bath house and have praised its facilities.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
他对各种沐浴方式很感兴趣，于是不断扩建浴场，才有了今天的规模。来访宅邸的客人也都赞赏这里的设施。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Because of that, the mansion's bathhouse became very famous. I hope that you get replenished in this historic bath house.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
因此宅邸浴场声名远播。希望您能在这座历史悠久的浴场里恢复精力。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Please come, your party is already here.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
请过来，您的队伍已经到了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is everyone gathered? In pairs, follow the procedures for searching dangerous goods and for searching missing persons. Send a signal when you find anything, and the meeting area is in the lounge.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大家都到齐了吗？两人一组，按流程搜查危险物品和失踪人员。发现线索就发信号，集合地点在休息室。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We should focus on searching for the dangerous goods rather than the missing persons. The identity of the dangerous being has not yet been revealed, and various testimonies and circumstances presumed it's a humans, monster, automatic doll, and supernatural beings.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
搜查重点应该放在危险物品上，而不是失踪人员。目前还不知道危险实体是什么，根据证词和迹象，它可能是人类、魔物、自动人偶或超自然生物。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Denny and Canine. The humans are likely to be individual or groups of Illusion remnants or a third party. There is also the possibility of them using a different exit other than what is known, so check the facilities carefully.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
丹尼和卡尼恩，人类目标可能是幻影残党，也可能是第三方。也不排除他们从未知出口离开了，所以请仔细检查设施。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Cyan and Danae. Next is the monsters. Since it's a bathhouse, it's assumed that there are aquatic monsters, or something like them. So focus on the bath and pipes.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
赛安和达娜厄，接下来是魔物。既然这里是浴场，推测可能有水生魔物或类似生物。重点检查浴池和管道。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If it's a broken automatic doll, you know this mansion well, so you'll have to listen to the bath managers first. I'll do this one.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果是故障的自动人偶，你们更熟悉这座宅邸，先听听浴场管理员的意见。这部分由我负责。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Last but not the least, if it's a ghost...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
最后但同样重要的是，如果那是幽灵......

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I know!! I'll take a look! At the ceiling! and drains!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我知道！！我去检查！天花板！还有排水沟！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Okay. Magenta. Go with Molar.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
......好吧。玛根塔，和莫拉尔一起去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer meet with the other managers like me to check if there's anything suspicious about the other automatic dolls. I have to get the blueprints first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，请和我一起去找其他管理员，看看有没有可疑的自动人偶。我得先去拿蓝图。

scripts.text: Ching
scripts.translation: 叮。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I think I should start with this ^0000CDsteam^000000.
It's so blurry, I can't barely see things.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我想先检查这股^0000CD蒸汽^000000。
雾太浓了，几乎什么都看不清。

scripts.text: I'll go to the Boiler Room.
scripts.translation: 我去锅炉房。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好，我去神龛那里拿蓝图。冒险者，请到<NAVI>[锅炉房]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，让他们停下设备。我很快就追上你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好，我去神龛那里拿蓝图。冒险者，请到<NAVI>[锅炉房]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，让他们停下设备。我很快就追上你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I usually go on a mission alone, but this is the first time I haven't heard from him in so long. That's why everyone is looking for him anxiously. Something happened. Think about it quickly.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我平时都是独自执行任务，但从没这么久联系不上他。大家才会这么焦急地找他。肯定出事了，快想想办法。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Even if you say that, I have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
你这么说，我也无可奉告。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hm? Adventurer? The boiler seems to have stopped, where do you plan on going?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯？冒险者？锅炉好像停了，你接下来打算去哪儿？

scripts.text: Didn't you say that we should go to the lake?
scripts.translation: 你不是说要去湖边吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who? ... me? Adventurer, did you really ^0000CDsee me^000000?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁？......我吗？冒险者，你真的^0000CD看见我^000000了吗？

scripts.text: Come to think of it...

[Rookie]
The tone seemed stiff and perplexed... That's definitely not me. I guess it's the unknown entity that appears in this bathhouse.
That's quite a headache. I can't believe it can mimic other people's appearance. No, in a way, it's better than that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
刚才那人的语气僵硬又困惑......那绝对不是我。看来这就是浴场里的未知实体。
真棘手，竟然能模仿别人的样子。不，或许它还能做得更多。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Seeing that I told you to go to the lake, I think it was trying to get you out of the bathhouse somehow. So it's not a supernatural being.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
它让你去湖边，应该是想把你从浴场引开。所以它不是超自然生物。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Whatever it is, we'll have to settle it before it falls to chaos.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管那是什么，我们都得赶在局势失控前解决。

scripts.text: P-peeep-

[Rookie]
Adventurer, let's go to the <NAVI>[lounge]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，我们去<NAVI>[休息室]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Your party went to the <NAVI>[lounge]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
您的队伍去了<NAVI>[休息室]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
How's the search for the creature going?
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
寻找那只生物的进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Aren't you in a middle of an operation?
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
你们不是正在执行任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Is there any inconvenience in using the bathhouse?
scripts.translation:
[神龛]
使用浴场时有什么不便吗？

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多，无法继续交谈。
请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Uhh, human guests shouldn't just come in here. This place is not very durable.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
呃，人类客人不该随便进这里。这里的设备不太结实。

scripts.text: I have something to check.
scripts.translation: 我有事要检查。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Umm... I can't stop you. But be careful with the pipes. It'll melt your skin when you touch it in the wrong place.
But what's the point? We don't have much time.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
嗯......我拦不住你，不过要小心管道。碰错地方会烫伤。
不过检查又有什么用呢？我们没多少时间了。

scripts.text: Please shut down the boiler.
scripts.translation: 请把锅炉关掉。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Boiler? ^0000CDIt's already stopped^000000, right? That's weird. The steam is still coming out? Is the boiler not working? Look at this. I was checking it out while it's on stop.
Is it because the water hasn't cooled down yet? Anyways, I already turned the boiler off.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
锅炉？^0000CD它已经停了^000000吧？真奇怪，蒸汽还在冒？难道锅炉没关好？你看，我刚检查过，开关明明是关着的。
可能是水还没冷却吧。总之我已经关掉锅炉了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I think this will be perfect. Oh... it's not perfect, but it's useful.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
我觉得这办法挺好......不算完美，不过很实用。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Have you seen this a lot on your way here?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
你一路上经常看到这种东西吗？

scripts.text: No, I've never seen it before.
scripts.translation: 没有，我以前从没见过。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Um... I picked it up on the way here, and it looked like an automatic doll accessory. There are so many people out there that I thought they were all over the place. I was going to pick it up and repair it.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
嗯......我路上捡到的，看起来像自动人偶的零件。外面人很多，我还以为这种东西到处都是。本来想捡起来修好。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
By the way, broken dolls are still appearing out of order. Why is that even if we fix broken automatic dolls, broken dolls are still appearing? Is the errors self-replicating?
I can't even clean up properly. But I have to anyway. I have to thank you.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
对了，故障人偶还是不断出现。为什么修好一台，新的故障人偶又会冒出来？错误会自我复制吗？
我甚至没法好好清理，但无论如何都得做。还是谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
... are you not going? I already turned off the boiler. Isn't that why you came here?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
......你还不走吗？锅炉已经关了，你不是为这事来的吗？

scripts.text: Is it an automatic doll?
scripts.translation: 那是自动人偶吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
What? The monster?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
什么？你说魔物？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I don't think so. Didn't you think ever think we'd notice it first, if it was?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我觉得不是。如果真是魔物，我们应该早就发现了吧？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Those things out there are the work of the invaders... They want it to be like that.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
外面那些东西都是入侵者搞出来的......他们就是想把事情弄成这样。

scripts.text: What do you think about the monster?
scripts.translation: 你觉得那个魔物是什么？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Maybe it's the ^0000CDghost in the boiler^000000.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
也许是^0000CD锅炉幽灵^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
The ghost. Don't you know what a ghost is? Do you know about it {0}? It's a something that died, and floats around without a physical form.
What happens here is very similar to what the ghost humans talk about.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
幽灵啊。你不知道吗？{0}，你知道幽灵是什么吗？那是死者失去实体后，仍在世间游荡的存在。
这里发生的事，很像人类口中的幽灵现象。

scripts.text: Then, the identity of the ghost...
scripts.translation: 那么，幽灵的身份是......

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Um... I don't it's what you're thinking. Ah~ I thought it was a human ghost. But no, I think it was the automatic doll that used to manage this place before I even came.
It was a small bath boiler at the time, and it was often overloaded with water from so many baths. It couldn't withstand the high pressure.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
嗯......恐怕不是你想的那样。啊~我原以为是人类的幽灵，不过现在觉得可能是以前负责这里的自动人偶。
那时浴场锅炉还很小，却常因浴池使用过度而超负荷，根本承受不住压力。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Anyways, it exploded while I was working on it, and the other automatic doll was burned down. Maybe it's that automatic doll.
I wonder if that doll's data was engraved in some unknown way. In this boiler.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
总之，我维修时锅炉爆炸了，另一台自动人偶也被烧毁。也许就是那台人偶。
不知道它的数据是否以某种未知方式留在锅炉里了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
This boiler move sometimes on its own without anyone using it, but I think the data from the past automatic dolls remains and continues to carry out commands.
Then it makes sense to hear the sound without form and make noises. You can also see strange shapes because of the steam that comes out.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
没人使用时，锅炉有时也会自己运转。我想是过去那台自动人偶的数据残留下来，继续执行指令。
这样一来，没有实体却能听见声音、发出噪音也就说得通了。蒸汽还会形成奇怪的形状。

scripts.text: That's quite scary.
scripts.translation: 听起来真吓人。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
It's scary. The valve here think it's just a boiler. Is it scary? Valve, look over here.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
是挺吓人的。这里的阀门却觉得这只是普通锅炉。阀门，你觉得可怕吗？看这边。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
Beep-
scripts.translation:
[阀门]
哔——

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
The boiler's spectre, do you think it makes sense? It's probably because of a problem that we haven't found yet. But maybe because we are automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
锅炉幽灵？你觉得这说得通吗？可能还有我们没发现的故障。也许是因为我们都是自动人偶......

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
We think that there must be something missing because we can't hear the sounds or feel the signs like the human guests.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我们不像人类客人那样听得到声音、察觉到迹象，所以觉得一定遗漏了什么。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
But in the end, we didn't even notice the existence of the problem. Problems that we probably won't find because of the limitations of us being a doll.
That's why I suggested to find the problem with the guests.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
说到底，我们甚至没意识到问题存在。受限于人偶的能力，有些问题我们可能永远发现不了。
所以我才建议让客人帮忙查找。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Honestly, we didn't know what was weird because there were no customers for a long time. Not until the human guests came in, so isn't it reasonable to note the difference between humans and automatic dolls?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
说实话，长时间没有顾客时，我们根本不知道哪里不对。直到人类客人来了才发现问题。比较人类和自动人偶的差异，不是很合理吗？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I heard that humans have developed senses and emotions. And the thinking ability to put it all together.
We only collect information and find a conclusion, but humans are different. I've heard you gather all personal experiences, thoughts, and imagination to come up with a conclusion.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我听说人类有发达的感官和情感，也能把这些整合起来思考。
我们只能收集信息、推导结论；人类则会结合个人经历、想法和想象得出结论。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I hope we can solve the problem.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
希望我们能把问题解决。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Since the boiler has been turned off. Please tell the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to search freely.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
锅炉已经关了。请告诉<NAVI>[其他客人]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，现在可以自由搜查了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Sweep, go meet the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. I have to keep my eyes on the boiler. If you find out anything, come here and let me know. Because I'm curious.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
斯威普，去找<NAVI>[其他客人]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。我得看着锅炉。有什么发现就回来告诉我，我很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
It would be better to look somewhere else than this place.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
最好再去别处看看。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
What are you curious about? Do you have any questions for us?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
你对什么好奇？有什么想问我们的吗？

scripts.text: Boiler...
About medicinal herbs...
scripts.translation: 关于药草......

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Medicinal herbs? Are you curious about the herbs that is used in the bath? Why? Is the bath water not to your liking?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
药草？你对浴池里用的药草感兴趣吗？为什么？是不喜欢浴水吗？

scripts.text: I really like it.
scripts.translation: 我很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Is that why you came here?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
所以你是为这个来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Boiler? Are you curious about the boiler? Why? Are you planning to steal the boiler?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
锅炉？你对锅炉感兴趣？为什么？你打算把它偷走吗？

scripts.text: Steal the boiler?
scripts.translation: 偷锅炉？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Oh, am I wrong? The intruder was very interested in the boiler and the supply system. They stealed the other boiler without my knowledge.
But. {0} doesn't seem to be interested in it. I was just wondering if you wanted to take the boiler. If i'm wrong then nevermind.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
哦，我猜错了吗？入侵者对锅炉和供水系统很感兴趣，还趁我不注意偷走了另一台锅炉。
不过，{0}似乎没兴趣。我只是想知道你是不是也想偷锅炉，猜错了就算了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
But what will the intruder do with it? Do you think they're planning on making an open-air bath?
Hmm.. I don't really know what they could do with the boiler. Can you humans make anything out of it? Do you have an idea, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
不过，入侵者偷锅炉要做什么？想建露天浴场吗？
嗯......我实在想不出用途。人类能用锅炉做什么？{0}，你有主意吗？

scripts.text: What else did they do?
scripts.translation: 他们还做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Hmmm... I liking soaking myself, but I'm more obsessed with the boiler. They seemed to be interested in the purification facility.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
嗯......我喜欢泡澡，不过我更迷锅炉。他们似乎也对净化设施很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I was excited to explain about boilers. But I didn't know that they would steal it. I~ really didn't know. Is humans famous for acting on a whim?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
我还兴致勃勃地给他们讲锅炉知识，没想到他们居然会偷走锅炉。我......真的没想到。人类都这么随心所欲吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
{0}, are you acting on whim too? I don't know much about humans yet. There's a lot to know. That's how I prepare. I won't let them steal it again.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
{0}，你也这么随性吗？我对人类还不太了解，有很多东西要学。
所以我得做好准备，不会再让他们偷走东西了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
For example. My master says that it's cool when he soaked in the bath, but when I soaked myself. It's incredibly hot. Did I set the temperature wrong? I did, but it wasn't for him.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
比如，主人说泡澡很凉爽，可我自己泡时却觉得烫得受不了。是温度设错了吗？确实是我调的，不过那是按主人的要求设定的。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
But it's cool. What does that mean? Am I mistaken?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
他说凉爽是什么意思？是我弄错了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
And then. If you soak these dry leaves in hot water, the contents of the leaves comes out. But it's just that.
But somehow it's good for your health, that's why we fill every bath with herbal leaves. Do humans breath on their skins? Or do you drink water from your skins?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
还有，把干叶子泡在热水里，叶子的成分就会出来，仅此而已。
可听说这对健康有益，所以每个浴池都放了草药叶。人类会用皮肤呼吸吗？还是用皮肤喝水？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Humans are happy to immerse themselves in the bath. Why is that?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
人类为什么喜欢把身体泡在浴池里呢？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Oh, there's another one! Why do you put ground seaweed in the bath and apply the water on your face?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
哦，还有！为什么要把磨碎的海藻放进浴池，再把水敷在脸上？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I was so curious that I tried it myself, but I didn't know what it was good for. Maybe because I'm an automatic doll?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
我很好奇，就自己试了试，可不知道有什么用。难道是因为我是自动人偶？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
If I had five senses like humans, I could have understand humans better. Why didn't the master gave us that?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
如果我也有和人类一样的五感，就能更理解人类了。主人为什么没给我们这些能力呢？

scripts.text:
[Valve]
It's all done. You have to drink now.
scripts.translation:
[阀门]
都准备好了，现在该喝了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I'm not going to drink. No one's drinking.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
我才不喝。谁都别喝。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
Is not ready yet? Can't you just drink a little? Squeeze it out and you'll get a lot of essence.
scripts.translation:
[阀门]
还没好吗？不能先喝一点吗？挤一挤就能挤出很多精华。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Valve. Humans are not tea bags. Remember, I've said this many times.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
阀门，人类不是茶包。我已经说过很多次了。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
All you have to do is boil the water well.
scripts.translation:
[阀门]
把水烧开就行了。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
The temperature needs to be increased to make it better.
scripts.translation:
[阀门]
水温得再高一些才好。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I told you not to touch the boiler.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
我说过别碰锅炉。

scripts.text: - Ack! -

[Boiler]
Stop it and come over here.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
住手，过来这边。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
It's okay because it's quiet for a while.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
暂时安静下来了，应该没事。

scripts.text: It looks dangerous, but the disposal...
scripts.translation: 看起来很危险，不过......要把它报废吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Why waste it! It'll still be useful if we fix it. Who am I supposed to work with if you scrap Valve? I don't like strangers.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
为什么要报废！修好后还能用。要是你把阀门拆掉，我和谁一起工作？我不喜欢陌生人。

scripts.text: Why don't you fix it?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不自己修？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Because I can't leave my hands off the boiler? The intruders broke the boiler and the valves, and there was no time to fix them.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
因为我得一直看着锅炉啊！入侵者弄坏了锅炉和阀门，当时根本没时间修。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I'm alone and the boiler room has to be ran by two, but I'm the only one left. There's no time to fix it. I can send it somewhere else, I'm worried that they'll reformat the data.
It's not so serious, I can fix it slowly. Valve is not that bad, it only touches the boiler sometimes. I don't know much about humans, but I know a lot about herbs and boilers.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
锅炉房原本要两个人一起运作，现在只剩我一个，根本抽不出时间修。送去别处修的话，我又怕他们把数据重置。
情况也没那么糟，我可以慢慢修。阀门还好，只是偶尔会碰到锅炉。我不太懂人类，但很懂药草和锅炉。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
But I still have to fix it.
Hmm... {0}? Are you free?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
不过我还是得修。
嗯......{0}，你有空吗？

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 为什么？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
If you're free, please help me. I'm short on hands. The valve and the boiler needs to be fixed. But I'm alone and the other dolls are busy.
I wish I were two. Wow... wouldn't it be nice? If there were two of me, this would be the best boiler room.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
有空的话请帮帮我，人手不够。锅炉和阀门都要修，但我一个人忙不过来，其他人偶也都很忙。
真希望我能有两个自己！那样这里就是最棒的锅炉房了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I'll ask Alpha to clone me. I don't know if it's possible, but logically, it's more efficient if there's two of me.
But, what can I do right now? There's no other me. I should ask for help. So please help me if you're free.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
我会请阿尔法克隆一个我。不知道能不能做到，但按理说两个我效率更高。
不过眼下没有另一个我，只能找人帮忙。所以有空的话请帮帮我。

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙。

scripts.text: I have to go take a bath.
scripts.translation: 我得去洗澡了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Really? Then there's nothing I can do. You also look tired, so I'll send you herbs for recovery. Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
这样啊，那我也没办法。你看起来也累了，我给你些恢复用的药草吧。再见。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Thank you. Then, can you handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000? I also need 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
谢谢。能帮忙处理20个^0000CD故障自动人偶^000000，带回5个^0000CD故障自动人偶零件^000000吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Yes, then please.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
好，那就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
What brings you here today? Oh, is it for work?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
今天来有什么事？哦，是来帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I came to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我来打个招呼。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Yes, I don't know why you are here. Nothing has changed here. We are still working on the boiler.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
嗯，我也不知道你为什么来。这里没什么变化，我们还在忙着修理锅炉。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Umm... I heard humans break down easily if they work too much. Please go get some rest and come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
嗯......听说人类工作太久会累坏。先去休息吧，天亮后再回来。

scripts.text: Let me handle it.
scripts.translation: 让我来处理。

scripts.text: I'l like to take a break today.
scripts.translation: 我今天想休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
That's weird. I thought you came to see me because you want to get work, right? Well, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
真奇怪，我还以为你是来找活干的。嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
How can there be such a sincere human? Then, today too please handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000 and bring 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
竟然有这么热心的人类！那今天也拜托你处理20个^0000CD故障自动人偶^000000，并带回5个^0000CD故障自动人偶零件^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Are you done with your work?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
工作做完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
零件呢？我们需要5个故障自动人偶零件。你的包是不是破了？检查一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Did you handle the 20 Broken Automatic Dolls? Are you injured somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
20个故障自动人偶都处理了吗？有没有受伤？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
零件呢？我们需要5个故障自动人偶零件。你的包是不是破了？检查一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Are you done with your work?
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
工作做完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
You've brought a lot. Well, I'll trade it for this barmeal ticket. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
你带来不少啊。好吧，我用这张餐券和你交换。谢谢。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多，无法继续交谈。
请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What's going on? See you come all the way here, are you here to look at something at the boiler?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
怎么了？你特地跑来这里，是想看看锅炉吗？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
The boiler is already stopped. Isn't that why you're here? Shouldn't you go and report?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
锅炉不是已经停了吗？你是为这事来的吧？那该去报告了。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Is there anything left to see here? Didn't you have something to do?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
这里还有什么可看的？你不是还有别的事要做吗？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What's going on? Do we still have a story to hear? Haven't you found the all the answer for the monsters?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
怎么了？还有什么事要问吗？关于魔物的答案不是都找到了吗？

scripts.text: I'd like to talk to you.
scripts.translation: 我想和你聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What do you want to talk about? The only thing I can talk about is cleaning. Are you curious about cleaning?
Hygiene is very important here because it's a public bath. Besides cleaning regularly everyday, I do it as often as necessary.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
想聊什么？我只懂清洁。你对清洁感兴趣吗？
公共浴场的卫生非常重要。我们每天定期清洁，也会在有需要时随时打扫。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Automatic dolls for cleaning sweeps foreign substances and dirt all over the place. This basic policy is to send all the guests out of the bathhouse when cleaning, but if the guest want to continue taking a bath, we shouldn't bother them and wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
负责清洁的自动人偶会清除各处的异物和污垢。通常清洁时会请客人离开浴场，但如果客人想继续泡澡，我们就不能打扰，只能等他们结束。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
However, it is not recommended that the automatic dolls that come out for cleaning should not be approached as much as possible because they are dangerous and they're for cleaning purposes only.
Actually, the cleaning dolls wasn't as strong as it is now. The measure was taken inevitably because of the intruders.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
清洁时出现的自动人偶很危险，而且只负责打扫，所以最好不要靠近。
其实清洁人偶以前没这么强，是入侵者闯入后，我们才不得不采取这种措施。

scripts.text: Because of the intruders?
scripts.translation: 因为入侵者？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Have you seen the intruder before? When I found them in the bath, my switch for intruder was activated, I didn't let them in. But they came by swarm and forced their way in.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你以前见过入侵者吗？他们闯进浴场时，我的入侵者警报启动了，所以没有放他们进来。可他们成群强闯，硬是进去了。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
They went through places where you can fit your body, such as water pipes and drains. The fish from the lake are also able to enter through the pipes.
Thanks to them, cleaning became more difficult. The intruder even interfered when I was cleaning. And they didn't even bother helping me clean after.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
他们钻过能容纳身体的地方，比如水管和排水沟。湖里的鱼也会从管道游进来。
多亏他们，清洁难度增加了。入侵者甚至在我打扫时捣乱，事后也不帮忙收拾。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
This is a bathhouse. Hygiene should be the top priority. The cleaner automatic dolls are strengthened because of that.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
这里是浴场，卫生应该摆在第一位。因此我们强化了清洁人偶。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
The intruder took a step back however they're not completely gone yet. Therefore, the cleaner dolls had no choice but to remain the strengthened form. So be careful when coming into contact during cleaning time.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
入侵者虽然暂时退走，却还没有彻底离开。所以清洁人偶不得不继续保持强化状态。清洁时遇到它们要小心。

scripts.text: Were you interrupted a lot?
scripts.translation: 他们经常打扰你吗？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I don't know what the humans want.
However, humans needs to take a bath and the space to do so. The task that was given to me was cleaning. It's all I know.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我不知道人类想要什么。
不过人类需要洗澡，也需要洗澡的地方。我的工作就是清洁，我只知道这些。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
There were two groups of intruders. One was obsessed with the bath and the other one is in it's facilites. What they had in common is that they're both obsessed with something.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
入侵者分成两拨。一拨痴迷于泡澡，另一拨则盯上这里的设施。他们都有各自执着的目标。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Humans that are obsessed with bathing did not cooperate with the cleaning, and humans obsessed with the facilities destroyed the facilites and the automatic dolls managing it.
The boiler was ripped apart and stolen, pipes were broken, and automatic dolls are dismantled. The other say they don't know how long will it take to recover from this. The situation in the other part of the mansion is not much different, the entire mansion is in this predicament.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
痴迷泡澡的那伙人不配合清洁，盯上设施的那伙人则破坏设施和管理设施的自动人偶。
锅炉被拆走，管道被弄坏，人偶也被拆解。听说修复需要很长时间。宅邸其他区域也差不多，整个宅邸都陷入困境。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What is the biggest feature that distinguish guests from the intruders? Why do guests and intruders have different behavior patterns? How do humans tell the difference between the two?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
客人和入侵者最大的区别是什么？为什么他们的行为模式不同？人类又是怎么分辨他们的？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
We, the automatic dolls, think it's natural that we don't know because we've only been in contact with guests before.
We can't feel things that humans can. I can't even feel the touch of the end of my hand.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我们自动人偶以前只接触过客人，所以不知道这些也很正常。
我们感受不到人类能感受到的东西，甚至连指尖的触感都感觉不到。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
But even if I don't know such thing, It won't impose a problem on my work. I can clean. I can carry out the task that was given to me. What is designated as trash should be swept away.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
不过，不了解这些并不影响我的工作。我能打扫，也能完成指派的任务。被认定为垃圾的东西就该扫走。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Human beings are human beings, automatic dolls are automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
人类就是人类，自动人偶就是自动人偶。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
But... I'd be happy if you could help me with one thing. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
不过......你愿意帮我一件事吗？我会很高兴的。

scripts.text: I'd be happy to.
scripts.translation: 我很乐意。

scripts.text: I'm a little busy.
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I see. I understand. I learned that I should not take the time of a busy guest.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我明白。忙碌的客人不该被打扰。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000. They are one of the main cause of the miss in the bathhouse.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
那么，请帮我消灭^0000CD15只沸腾食人鱼和15只沸腾马克^000000。它们是浴场难以保持清洁的主要原因。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Other parts of the mansion are also lacking in hands, so we have to do it ourselves. I clean up whenever I can, but there are too many. It must not be delayed too much because it's about hygiene and safety. Then, please.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
宅邸其他地方也人手不足，只能由我们自己处理。我尽可能随时清扫，可数量实在太多。卫生和安全不能耽搁。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What's the matter? Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
怎么了？你是来帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I'm curious about cleaning.
scripts.translation: 我对清洁很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Cleaning is something I do usually. It's just difficult at the moment since there are too many obstacles.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
清洁是我平时的工作。只是现在障碍太多，做起来比较困难。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Um.. I'm happy that you're here to help me. But I've heard that humans need a lot of rest. Please come back again after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
嗯......你愿意帮忙，我很高兴。不过我听说人类需要充分休息，请天亮后再来。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Thank you for your help. Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
谢谢你愿意帮忙。能请你消灭^0000CD15只沸腾食人鱼和15只沸腾马克^000000吗？

scripts.text: All right.
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text: I'd like to take a break today..
scripts.translation: 我今天想休息一下......

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I see. I've heard that humans should rest often.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我明白。听说人类需要经常休息。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Then I'll let you handle it.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
那就交给你了。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Have you dealt with it?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
处理好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Did you forgot about it? then please exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
忘了吗？那就请去消灭^0000CD15只沸腾食人鱼和15只沸腾马克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Have you dealt with it?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
处理好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Perfect. Thank you very much. I'd be more grateful if you could come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[锅炉]
太好了，非常感谢。要是天亮后还能再来，我会更感激。

scripts.text:
^006600��Nameless Spring��^000000
^006600This is the place when you want to forget everything and immerse yourself into nature. However, if things are too difficult. Please come to us for assistance.^000000
scripts.translation:
^006600无名之泉^000000
^006600想忘却烦恼、融入自然时，就来这里吧。若遇到难题，请来找我们帮忙。^000000

scripts.text:
^006600��Footbath��^000000
^006600No need to be grand. Feel free to go and soak your feet.^000000

^006600��Fountain of Wisdom - Public Bath��^000000
^006600The oldest and most famous bath in Varmundt Mansion. Soak yourself in this bath and think about the deepest, most difficult things in your heart. The answer will surely come up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^006600智慧之泉——公共浴池^000000
^006600这是瓦尔蒙特宅邸最古老、最有名的浴池。泡在里面，静下心思考心中最深、最难的问题，答案一定会浮现。^000000

scripts.text:
^006600��Cold Spring - Cold Bath��^000000
^0000CDSoak yourself in the cold spring if you want to be ice-cold. The cold air in the bath will bring together your disordered spirit.^000000
scripts.translation:
^006600冷泉——冷水浴^000000
^0000CD想让全身冰凉的话，就来泡冷泉。浴池里的寒气会让纷乱的心神平静下来。^000000

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多，无法继续交谈。
请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
This place is dangerous.
Please come back again when you are able to protect yourself better.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
这里很危险。等你有能力保护自己时再来吧。

scripts.text: - You must be atleast level 160 to perform this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你必须至少达到160级才能进行此任务。-

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Since all places are open to special guests, we can't stop you from coming in here. However, if you're going to look around the warehouse, you shouldn't touch anything here.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
特别访客可以进入所有区域，所以我不能阻止你。不过在仓库里参观时，请不要碰任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
What a mess is this.
How did you come in here?
You don't even have a key with you.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
这里怎么乱成这样？
你是怎么进来的？
身上连钥匙都没有。

scripts.text: What's this place for?
scripts.translation: 这里是做什么的？

scripts.text: I don't want to cause trouble, I'll go back.
scripts.translation: 我不想惹麻烦，先走了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Maybe you just got in accidentally.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你可能是不小心闯进来的。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
A human.
In addition... a guest?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
人类......
而且还是客人？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Did you come here to find the mansion's blueprint?
I'll bring it to you, if you can wait.
I remember the saying, that human lacks patience.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你是来找宅邸蓝图的吗？愿意等的话，我可以拿给你。
我记得有句俗话说，人类都没什么耐心。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
This is the second warehouse of the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
这里是瓦尔蒙特宅邸的第二仓库。

scripts.text: Warehouse...?

[Chirp]
Oh, is there no concept of warehouse for humans outside? The warehouse is where you store things that you don't use.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
怎么，外面的人类没有仓库的概念吗？仓库就是存放暂时不用的东西的地方。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I came here to get the mansion's blueprint and the ingredients for the restaurant. Did you come here in person because you don't trust me? If that's the case, please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我来这里取宅邸蓝图和餐厅食材。你是因为不放心，才亲自来的吗？如果是这样，请不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I've been in charge of the warehouse for a very long time, I can quickly old or very small items that have been stored.
Needless to say, I also remember where the blueprint is.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我管理仓库很久了，不管是旧物还是很小的东西，都能很快找到。
当然，我也记得蓝图放在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I'm an automatic doll. We don't lose memories.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我是自动人偶，不会忘记。

scripts.text: I'm not looking for a blueprint.
scripts.translation: 我不是来找蓝图的。

scripts.text: This place is very complicated.
scripts.translation: 这里真复杂。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Is that so? I misunderstood the situation.
I didn't think there would be any humans visiting the warehouse. Usually the humans that come all the way here were usually thieves.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
这样啊，是我误会了。我没想到会有人类来仓库。通常特地跑来这里的人类都是小偷。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
That doesn't mean that you are a thief. Becayse you wouldn't have qualified as a guest. The Varmundt Mansion does not invite everyone as a guest.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
不过这不代表你是小偷，因为你已经获准成为客人了。瓦尔蒙特宅邸不会随便邀请人来做客。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Even if you have that intention, it won't be easy to find what you want here anyway.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
就算你另有企图，在这里也不容易找到想要的东西。

scripts.text: This place is very complicated.
scripts.translation: 这里真复杂。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Of course, it's an old warehouse of Varmundt.
It's this big now because there is not enough space to keep all items from all over the continent, that's why we constantly expanded and renovated it.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
当然，这里是瓦尔蒙特的旧仓库。由于要存放来自大陆各地的物品，空间逐渐不够，我们才不断扩建翻修，变成现在这么大。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Although it looks complex from what the eyes see, It's really not that complicated because everything is organized according to it classification.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
看起来杂乱，其实并不复杂，所有东西都按类别整理好了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
This is only possible because it is a very large space unlike what you see outside. So if you're waiting for it, please go back and wait for me... I'll bring it to you soon.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
外面看着没这么大，不过这里空间非常宽敞，所以才能这样分类存放。愿意等的话，请先回去等我，我很快就把东西拿来。

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 为什么？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I think I'll be delayed a little because of the broken cleaning robots. It's an automatic robot that was hacked by the intruders. I'm thinking of how to clean the mess it made.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
故障的清洁机器人让我耽搁了一会儿。那是一台被入侵者黑掉的自动机器人。我得想办法收拾它弄出的烂摊子。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
^CC0000Setting it on fire^000000 will be the cleanest way, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
^CC0000直接把它烧掉^000000，应该是最干净利落的办法吧？

scripts.text: What? Everything will be burnt.
scripts.translation: 什么？那样所有东西都会烧掉的！

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
That's okay. They're all fireproof. Even if it burns everything, the mansion plans are in the other warehouses. We have to go a little far, but it's fine. Rest assured.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
没关系，东西都是防火的。即使全烧了，宅邸蓝图也有备份在其他仓库。虽然得走远一点，但不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It's fastest and cleanest to handle everything at once.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
一次把所有东西都处理掉，最快也最干净。

scripts.text: That's not the problem...
scripts.translation: 问题不在这里......

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Then, what is the problem?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
那问题在哪里？

scripts.text: I'd rather call the security.
scripts.translation: 我宁愿叫保安来。

scripts.text: I'd rather call the superiors.
scripts.translation: 我宁愿叫上级来处理。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
What do you mean by calling the superiors?
Are you telling me to leave the superiors to solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
叫上级是什么意思？你是要把问题交给上级处理吗？

scripts.text:
